denver-colorado-rockies-guanella-pass-an.story: Leave the city behind and spend the day on roads with texture. A 511 km loop that starts and ends near Bennett, about 9 h 27 of riding. On the way it passes Greeley, near Loveland and Sheridan. The climbs: Near Greeley, on the way back, Guanella Pass and Georgetown, Scenic stretch near Perry Park and near Castle Rock. It tops out at about 3,400 m. Guanella Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off.
